title: MSFS 2020 Added a NUCLEAR flying aircraft ? ☢️ (Marketplace Review)
description:
🔍 Description
The MSFS 2020 Marketplace just dropped a huge wave of new aircraft and liveries — and this week is packed with exciting additions for both airliner fans and military aviation lovers! ✈️🔥

In this video, I break down all the new aircraft and new liveries released in the Marketplace for the week of January 12, 2026, including:

🛫 mscenery 737‑400 Professional
🛫 mscenery 737‑500 Professional
🛫 mscenery A350‑900ULR Professional
🛫 mscenery A380‑900 Professional
🛫 mscenery CL‑1201 Professional
🛫 mscenery E‑4B Nightwatch Professional
🎨 2PILOT C408 SkyCourier Ultimate Liveries

I’ll walk you through pricing, platform availability, and what makes each release worth checking out. Whether you're into heavy metal, futuristic concepts, or unique liveries to freshen up your fleet, there’s something here for every simmer.

If you enjoy MSFS content, don’t forget to like, subscribe, and hit the bell icon so you never miss a Marketplace breakdown!
Got a favorite from this week’s drop? Tell me in the comments — I’d love to hear what you’re flying next! ✈️💬
